parsed.diagnosis: FDIR isolates the first mild friction wheel with residual 0.3-0.5 mNm just over 0.3 mNm threshold, severity 0.2, then min_avail=3 blocks second isolation. Control continues on 3-wheel set containing the later severe friction/derate fault, causing attitude_loss/saturation. With 4 wheels the mild fault is tolerable, so no violation without policy.
parsed.rationale: Enable swap to keep healthiest 3 wheels: if another wheel trips while one is isolated and new residual >2x isolated residual and >=0.8mNm, re-enable mild isolated wheel <=0.6mNm and isolate new worse wheel. This corrects wrong-wheel-first isolation in friction+friction and friction+derate pairs without changing single-fault isolation thresholds or SAFE logic.
parsed.why_no_regressions: Single-fault/nominal behavior unchanged, swap needs second trip. Narrow gates allow swap only from mildly-degraded to clearly-worse wheel, keeping 3-wheel control. Cannot trigger spuriously.
